scripts.jmeter:install: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$u='https://archive.apache.org/dist/jmeter/binaries/apache-jmeter-5.6.3.zip'; $o='tools\apache-jmeter-5.6.3.zip'; if (!(Test-Path 'tools')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'tools' | Out-Null }; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -OutFile $o; Expand-Archive -Path $o -DestinationPath 'tools'; Remove-Item $o"
scripts.jmeter:plan: if exist "tools\apache-jmeter-5.6.3\bin\jmeter.bat" ("tools\apache-jmeter-5.6.3\bin\jmeter.bat" -n -t plan.jmx -l results.jtl) else (jmeter -n -t plan.jmx -l results.jtl)
scripts.jmeter:report: if exist "tools\apache-jmeter-5.6.3\bin\jmeter.bat" ("tools\apache-jmeter-5.6.3\bin\jmeter.bat" -g results.jtl -o jmeter-report) else (jmeter -g results.jtl -o jmeter-report)
